capabilities: Publish notes to public mininote links
Share folders as a single link mirroring every note under them
Push private copies without a public link and promote them later
One-way sync edits, moves, deletes and tags to published copies
Manage and resync all shares from a sidebar with per-share page settings
disambiguation: A publish plugin, not a sync plugin: notes flow one way from the vault to mininote, and mininote never writes back into the vault.
extras: Not yet in the Obsidian community store; installed via BRAT or manually from release files. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or newer on desktop for the OAuth sign-in flow. Local images are not published; only remote image URLs are kept.
problem: Obsidian notes live locally and there is no simple way to share a single note or folder as a public link while keeping the vault as the source of truth.

relations.evidence: Publish and share your Obsidian notes through mininote: push a note, get a public link.

summary: Publishing plugin that pushes notes or folders to the mininote service and returns a public link, with optional one-way syncing of changes.
